caption_L1: Here a is a bar graph labeled Average cost for tuition and other fees at universities in the United States from 2000/01 to 2017/18 (in U.S. dollars). The x-axis plots Year using categorical scale with 2000/01 on one end and 2017/18 at the other while the y-axis plots Average cost for tuition and fees using linear scale of range 0 to 15,000.
caption_L2L3: There is a consistent increase in the cost of tuition fees. 2000/2001 was the cheapest year. 2017/2018 was the most expensive year.
